text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, September 22, 2020, Appeal DDRT2021-01.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog and exempted the applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued September 22, 2020, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Debra Stocks and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before April 9, 2021.
